title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Plain-language tooltips for cron and durations
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.29.0 adds inline hover tooltips that translate cron and ISO 8601 duration string literals into plain language.

highlights.title: Inline Literal Tooltips
highlights.description: Cron expressions and ISO 8601 durations written as string literals now show a plain-language translation on hover, so you don't have to decode the syntax by hand.

sections.heading: Improvements
bullets: Added hover tooltips that translate cron expressions and ISO 8601 duration string literals (schedules, timeouts, delays) into plain language, right where you're reading the code.
Available in both desktop VS Code and VS Code for the Web.
Can be turned off via the kotlinJump.literalTooltips setting.
